name: codex-naming-studio
description: A Codex naming workbench rendered as a native Codex widget: GUI clicks wake Codex through follow-up messages, structured name analysis flows back through MCP state tools, no API key required.

interface.shortDescription: Collect naming constraints and let Codex return structured name analysis.
interface.longDescription: Codex Naming Studio renders a naming workbench as a native Codex widget. Users fill baby naming constraints and click generate; the widget saves the request and wakes Codex with a follow-up message, Codex runs bazi and research steps per the derived plan, and writes ranked Chinese name candidates with scoring, five-elements analysis, source notes, and full-dimension name breakdowns back to the GUI. A localhost browser workbench remains as a development fallback. No API key required.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Naming Studio workbench for this project.
Handle the pending Naming Studio request and write results back to the GUI.
